# contract-testing

Provider/consumer contract testing and property-based boundary fuzzing - Pact and Schemathesis are the tools the TESTING rules measure reports from.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-TEST-001` | high | The contract is executable — provider and consumer sides |
| `AF-TEST-002` | medium | Fuzz the boundary the contract declares |
| `AF-TEST-007` | high | Contract-breaking changes are detected before merge |
| `AF-TEST-102` | high | Schemathesis found contract-violating responses |
